Team,

Thank you all for the fast turn. After reviewing Markus' calibration points, Monica's comp context, and Laura's compensation thresholds, here's the decision and rationale:

1) Adjudication outcome: We will hold the offer at L2 but expand the scope of the role description to explicitly include the cross-team ownership examples Jordan demonstrated. Rationale: while Jordan demonstrates some L3 behaviors (mentorship, cross-team work), the candidate's interview performance did not consistently meet the L3 rubric across all technical anchors. To maintain leveling integrity across teams, we will not move to L3 without a stronger pattern in interviews.

2) Offer adjustments: Comp & Benefits (Laura) has approved a band exception within L2 to move Jordan to the top of the L2 compensation range + a one-time sign-on of $7,000 to acknowledge the breadth of responsibility. Monica, please update the offer packet and confirm the total OTE we will present.

3) Candidate communication: Monica and Rebecca, please present the outcome to Jordan using a transparent, empathetic note: acknowledge their examples, explain the rubric decision, and highlight the compensation goodwill and path to promotion (clear 6–9 month milestones tied to team outcomes). Copy HR (me) on the message. If Jordan refuses, we can consider reopening for L3 if they provide stronger published/manager-signed evidence of sustained L3 scope or if we run an expedited additional interview round focused on areas flagged as inconsistent.

4) Documentation: Monica, please attach the final offer packet and a 1-paragraph calibration memo from Markus into HR-CASE-2025-4527 so we have an audit trail.

I'll close this thread once offer is updated. Thanks for the thoughtful inputs — the candidate is engaged and we should move quickly.
